install: Run WuWa-VR-Setup.exe to install WuWa VR for your Windows user, then open the WuWa VR shortcut. This small installer does not include the VR mod: the first Install VR needs internet to download about 54 MB. No separate Python installation is needed.
steps: 01 · Game. Choose your Kuro or Steam installation. A saved choice is kept; if several installations are found, choose one. For Steam, browse to Wuthering Waves.exe if needed. You need your own copy of the game.
02 · Install VR. Read and accept the account-risk notice, then install the selected VR version. Existing settings and backups are kept.

03 · Headset or simulator. Start your headset software and check the runtime, or choose the simulator. Select Launch in VR and accept Windows permission. Steam launches the selected game through Steam; for Kuro, press Play in its launcher.
controls: In game, L3 + R3 opens UEVR settings. Custom options are under VR → WuWa Controls. L3 + A recenters and L3 + B shows or hides the game UI.
guide: Full setup, update and recovery steps
updates: Open 02 → Versions & updates → Check updates. From installed 1.0.2, choose Update launcher to download and verify 1.0.3. When the game, injector, recording and other operations are idle, choose Restart to update and confirm. Then explicitly select beta-2026-10-06-recovery in the step 02 version list and install it. Updating the app preserves the selected VR package; checking for updates does not select the new package. Both updates are needed for the recovery changes. Settings, backups, logs and recordings stay in their existing folders; keep older packages for rollback.
runtime: Choosing a simulator or restoring a headset changes the system OpenXR runtime and may ask for Windows permission. Close the game and injector first. The bundled simulator can now be selected on a PC with no runtime registration or in place of an old package’s simulator. Missing Visual C++ 2015–2022 x64 dependencies produce an actionable message. Opening or updating the app does not select the simulator automatically.
accepted: This beta updates startup status, error reporting, recovery and fresh-PC simulator setup. These changes have background test coverage. The previous 1.0.2 release failed to start on a remote Windows 11 Steam PC; the 1.0.3 retest there is pending, so this is not a confirmed fix for that PC. The renderer, injector and steam-20261006 build are unchanged. Game graphics choices and the earlier accepted foliage, far indirect-lighting, main Resonators reflection, ultimate-camera and 2D-brightness corrections are retained. Cinematic framing remains on by default; headset comfort remains pending.
rim: Suppress mismatched NPC rim lighting is under VR → WuWa Controls and starts off. It suppresses the toon-rim effect that produced extra bright contours in the tested NPC scene. It also removes that intended effect from nearby characters that use it. Turning it off restores the prior value if the workaround still owns it. The underlying stereo rendering fault is unresolved.
limits: Long scene/dialogue stalls, unreliable HUD-aspect refresh and moving backgrounds behind flat menus remain open. Manual mono theatre can help with menus. Weapon/Echo submenu reflections, distant NPC rim lighting, some fog/VFX and full-animation first-person aiming are unfinished. New startup feedback still needs the remote Windows 11 Steam retest; do not start another injector while the outcome is unknown. Epic injection and current headset acceptance remain unverified.
cutscenes: Two manual screen modes: fully hold LT + RT first, then click R3 for mono theatre (the same scene and HUD for both eyes), or hold L3 for 0.8 seconds for a stereoscopic screen. Release all controls before repeating, with UEVR and HUD/mouse adjustment closed. Automatic cinema is experimental and off by default: it did not activate for the latest reported in-engine scene, and an actual prerendered movie has not been tested. Keep the manual shortcut available.
risk: Use at your own risk. This unofficial mod injects into the game; anti-cheat may restrict or ban an account. It is not approved by Kuro Games.
portable: The portable ZIP is an advanced fallback: extract the whole archive, keep its app and python folders together, and open WuWa VR Launcher.exe. It uses the older browser interface and does not install or self-update the desktop app. The installer is the recommended starting point.
archive: Older translated setup instructions below describe the portable interface. Use the current installer steps in English or Simplified Chinese for the desktop app.
updateFallback: If the old launcher blocks its update, close the app and use the new WuWa-VR-Setup.exe from this website. This installs the app update; it does not guarantee that a stalled startup worker has stopped. Review remaining processes before changing the VR package or runtime.
recovery: In Troubleshooting → Stuck launcher processes, choose Find stuck launcher processes. Review each name, PID, role, start time, path and eligibility; elevation may be requested. Nothing is selected automatically. Choose an eligible verified launcher helper or startup worker, then use Stop selected and confirm the listed processes. Game, Steam, headset/runtime and injector processes are not termination targets. Runtime/profile changes and active or unknown recording state remain protected. Review each result, then explicitly choose Retry connection when ready; recovery does not reconnect or launch the game automatically. An inconclusive process may require manual handling; copy diagnostics instead of guessing from its name.
